job.title: Staff Security Software Engineer, Detection & Response
job.workplace: Remote-eligible; in the office 1–2 times every 6 months
job.pay_full: $177,185 – $364,795 a year base salary (US), plus equity

details.about: Pinterest is an inspiration platform that millions of people use to find creative ideas and plan for the future. Its Detection & Response team protects Pinterest's employees and infrastructure from security threats. This experienced security engineer builds and improves detection and response capabilities and adapts them to emerging threats, acting as a senior technical resource for the team.
duties: Act as a senior technical resource for the Detection & Response team
Identify capability gaps and help define the team's strategy and roadmap
Improve the detection engineering program and lead efforts to build new capabilities
Build alerts and automation workflows to detect and respond to external and internal threats
Manage logging pipelines and infrastructure, and onboard new log sources for better detection coverage
Develop and maintain internal tools that expand and automate detection and response
Respond to alerts and lead incidents as part of an on-call rotation
Hunt for previously undetected threats, and work with partners across security and engineering
Use AI to make security engineering faster, more accurate and broader in coverage
needs: Broad and deep knowledge of intrusion detection and incident response, engineering-focused, in a modern cloud-first environment
Knowledge of the attacker lifecycle, common attack techniques and detection methods
Hands-on experience writing SIEM queries for alerting, response and threat hunting
Experience using threat intelligence to improve detection
Familiarity with telemetry such as EDR, Osquery and firewall logs for investigations
Understanding of networking and/or network security, including basic TCP/IP
Depth in macOS internals (ideally), or Linux/UNIX or Windows internals, including persistence and privilege escalation techniques
Scripting or automation experience (e.g. Python, Go, Ruby)
Shown ability to use AI to improve speed and quality, with critical verification of AI-assisted work
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, a related field, or equivalent experience
details.benefits: Base salary $177,185 – $364,795 a year for US-based applicants; final salary depends on location, travel, experience and skills. The position is also eligible for equity. Pinterest lists the other benefits for this position on its careers site.
notes: Can be based anywhere in the US; in the office for in-person collaboration 1–2 times every 6 months

yt_title: Pinterest Is Hiring: Staff Security Engineer | Seattle or Remote US | $177K–$364K

scenes.head: Today's job
lines: Welcome to Veritas Recruitment Agency, where we bring you real tech jobs straight from employers' own careers sites.
Today, Pinterest is hiring a Staff Security Software Engineer for its Detection and Response team. You can be based in Seattle or work remotely from anywhere in the United States.
You'll find the direct application link in the description.

scenes.head: About Pinterest
bullets: Senior technical resource for the team
lines: Millions of people use Pinterest to find creative ideas and plan the things they care about.
The Detection and Response team protects Pinterest's employees and infrastructure from security threats, and this role is the team's senior technical resource, helping set its strategy and roadmap.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Run logging pipelines, add new log sources
lines: You'll build alerts and automated workflows that catch threats from outside and inside the company.
You'll manage logging pipelines, bring in new log sources for wider coverage, and build internal tools that automate detection and response.
You'll also hunt for threats nobody has spotted yet, and lead incidents as part of an on-call rotation.
And you'll use A I to make the team's security work faster and more accurate.
show: And you'll use AI to make the team's security work faster and more accurate.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: SIEM queries · threat intel · EDR, Osquery
lines: You'll need broad, deep knowledge of intrusion detection and incident response in a cloud-first company, and a solid grasp of how attackers operate.
You should be hands-on writing S I E M queries, using threat intelligence, and investigating with telemetry like E D R, Osquery, and firewall logs.
Pinterest also wants networking basics like T C P I P, deep knowledge of macOS, Linux, or Windows internals, and scripting in Python, Go, or Ruby.
You should be using A I in your daily work while carefully checking its results, and hold a degree in computer science or cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.
